meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会系统性阅读当前代码库的每一个源码文件原文,大文件通过分段方式读完,以建立对项目结构的认知。
howto.when: 当开始新项目或面对不熟悉的代码库,或你提到“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”“prime”等请求时触发。

say.text: 请通读这个项目的所有源码文件,给我一份整体认识。
say.note: Claude 会逐个文件完整读取后总结。

say.text: 我刚接手这个代码库,你先把全部源码读完。
say.note: 随后可直接针对代码提问。

say.text: 从头开始学习代码库,遇到大文件请分页读完。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude reads every source file in the current codebase from start to finish, using chunked reads for large files, to become familiar with the project layout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', 'prime', or similar.

say_en.text: Please read every source file in this project fully, then give me an overview.
say_en.note: Claude reads all files completely before summarizing.

say_en.text: I've just taken over this codebase; read all the source first.
say_en.note: You can then ask questions about the code.

say_en.text: Start learning the codebase from scratch; page through large files.
